response.sql:
WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink, u.acctscope, AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
mean_and_excess AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate,
         AVG(avg_fee_rate) OVER () AS mean_pair_average,
         avg_fee_rate - AVG(avg_fee_rate) OVER () AS excess
  FROM pair_averages
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY acctscope
           ORDER BY excess DESC, orderslink ASC
         ) AS rank
  FROM mean_and_excess
  WHERE avg_fee_rate > mean_pair_average
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_fee_rate, excess, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank;

assumptions.assumption: The mean is the unweighted arithmetic mean across all matched (orderslink, account scope) pair averages; pairs whose average fee rate is NULL are excluded from that mean, as SQLite AVG ignores NULL.
